title: 杰克逊霍尔年会前瞻：美联储新主席首秀引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: All right, Jackson Hole is next week, and as we get there, it's getting increasingly important.
segments.zh: 好的，杰克逊霍尔会议下周举行，随着会议临近，其重要性日益凸显。

segments.en: Of course, it was already important, given the fact that Kevin Worsh didn't have exactly rave reviews after his first FOMC meeting. And now there is a question of treasure secretary
segments.zh: 当然，鉴于凯文·沃什在首次FOMC会议后并未获得好评，这次会议本就重要。现在又涉及财政部长斯科特·贝森特施压的问题。

segments.en: Scott Besson really turning up the heat right about that. I do not know.
segments.zh: 斯科特·贝森特确实在加大压力，对此我不太确定。

segments.en: Do we know the Worsh's attending? Well, I don't know actually. I don't even know if he's giving a speech, right? And there's a good chance that if he does give a speech, it's not going to be
segments.zh: 我们是否知道沃什会出席？实际上我不知道，甚至不确定他是否会发表讲话。而且，如果他讲话，很可能不是前瞻性的政策讲话。

segments.en: a sort of forward policy speech. It's going to be something about Fed communication style, similar to what he delivered at that July presser. So I don't know. But it is just a really weird
segments.zh: 可能会是关于美联储沟通风格的内容，类似于他在7月记者会上的发言。所以我不确定，但正如你所说，这确实是个奇怪的时期。

segments.en: time, as you say, because like already, look, we have inflation going warmer than expected.
segments.zh: 因为我们已经看到通胀高于预期。

segments.en: We have rates rising at the long end, generally. Then we have this meeting, we really say very much.
segments.zh: 长期利率普遍上升，然后这次会议我们确实没说什么。

segments.en: And then we had the treasury intervention that lasted about five minutes. I think Scott Besson just misses trading. Well, clearly he is running the world's biggest hedge fund,
segments.zh: 接着是财政部的干预，只持续了大约五分钟。我认为斯科特·贝森特只是怀念交易，显然他在运营全球最大的对冲基金，只是没有他可能使用的杠杆。

segments.en: except without the same kind of leverage that he might have otherwise run. There is a question though about Fed Chair Kevin Worsh. What do you think is going to be giving a speech? He did say
segments.zh: 但关于美联储主席凯文·沃什，你认为他会发表讲话吗？他确实说过会出席并发表讲话，但表示目前还是一张白纸。

segments.en: he was going to be there and giving a speech, but said right now it's a blank sheet of paper.
segments.zh: 他说过会出席并发表讲话，但表示目前还是一张白纸。

segments.en: So unclear whether it's actually going to deliver something. My key question is how much will he lean against what Besson has said and try to say, look, that actually might make conditions more
segments.zh: 所以尚不清楚它是否会真正带来成果。我的关键问题是，他会在多大程度上反驳贝森的观点，并试图表明，这实际上可能使条件更加宽松。

segments.en: accommodative. Should they come in on some level? Right. So this is the crazy thing that's emerging now. There's this weird implicit tension between what the Fed is doing under Worsh and
segments.zh: 对，这就是现在出现的疯狂之处。在沃什领导下的美联储行动与某些层面之间，存在一种奇怪的隐性紧张关系。
